verdict.rationale: Justworks' own docs suggest it handles payroll tax work. It collects employees' filing status, withholding and exemption details so they needn't file a W-4. It also asks for quarter-end accuracy checks and for adjustments "before the adjustment deadline," and requests prior payroll history under the company EIN. Together these imply Justworks calculates withholding and files quarterly returns, but no item explicitly states it files and remits federal, state and local taxes automatically. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic federal/state/local tax filing and remittance, local-tax coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration.
